channel.title: Carat Capital — The Trade Paper of the Jewelry World
channel.description: Prices, intelligence and analysis from every desk of the stone trade: diamonds, gold and metals, gemstones, watches, auctions, retail and technology.

item.title: 8.41-carat pink diamond carries a HK$95m Christie's estimate
item.description: The pear-shaped type IIa stone is graded fancy vivid purple-pink, which works out at HK$11.3m a carat. A Cartier brooch set with a 10.10-carat Burmese ruby carries HK$60m at the same 24 November sale.

item.title: Silver adds $1.48 and retakes Monday's mark, gold stays under
item.description: All four metals rose on Wednesday's opening tick. Gold recovered $62.00 of the $80.40 it shed on Tuesday, which still leaves it $18.40 under the 14 September mark.

item.title: Rolex prices the Perpetual Padellone from US$59,000
item.description: The annual calendar arrives outside Watches and Wonders, in 39mm Everose gold or platinum. Platinum lists at US$66,200 and the Everose on a Settimo bracelet at US$72,800, per SJX Watches.

item.title: 30 minutes to under five: De Beers ships SynthDetect 2
item.description: The screening instrument cuts at least 25 minutes off a full tray scan and needs less operator input, De Beers Group Science and Technology says. No price is published.

item.title: Pandora must face FoundRae's copyright suit over Talisman charms
item.description: Judge Colleen McMahon denied the motion to dismiss on 10 September, finding a reasonable juror could hold that Pandora copied the design. Two medallions are at issue.

item.title: Lagos names Keith Rolfe CEO, 49 years after its founding
item.description: The Philadelphia house promoted its chief financial and operating officer with immediate effect on 10 September. Founder Steven Lagos becomes executive chairman, creative director and innovation officer.

item.title: GCAL by Sarine opens a third lab, in Mumbai's SEEPZ
item.description: The jewellery certification site joins labs in Surat and New York, and it is the second in India. Sarine announced it on 14 September, ahead of the peak export shipping season.

item.title: Platinum sheds $44 to $1,748 as all four metals fall
item.description: Gold gave back $80.40 an ounce and silver 2.24% against Friday's final marks on Kitco's bid. Platinum's 2.46% is the largest of the four percentage falls.

item.title: Macy's raises full-year sales guidance by $125m at midpoint
item.description: Fine jewelry was one of five categories named as outperforming in the second quarter. Comparable sales rose 2.7% group-wide and 11.3% at Bloomingdale's, and adjusted EPS guidance rose 15 cents.

item.title: Christie's estimates a David Morris ring at up to $2.6m
item.description: The 14.63-carat fancy orangey-pink stone leads nearly 300 lots from a single private collection. The live sale is on 10 November in Geneva, with an online sale running 5 to 17 November.

item.title: Amit Shah asks India to hold the whole lab-grown chain
item.description: Speaking in Mumbai on 13 September, the home minister named machines, production, jewellery, brands and showrooms. He put 2025 gems and jewellery exports at Rs 2.44 lakh crore and the workforce at 75 lakh.

item.title: Signet signs the $125m repurchase with JPMorgan Chase
item.description: The accelerated agreement is dated 10 September and Signet took an initial 1,023,000 shares the next day. About $575m of authorisation remains under the 2017 programme.

item.title: Luk Fook opens its first UK shop at Westfield Stratford
item.description: The Hong Kong group's network now runs to about 2,900 points of sale across 14 countries and regions. The shop opened on 10 September under a three-year plan to enter three new overseas markets.

item.title: Chow Tai Fook files to register RMB 10bn of panda bonds
item.description: The jewellery group has applied to China's interbank dealers' association to issue in tranches within two years of acceptance. Chow Tai Fook Services, a separate Hong Kong listing, registered half that amount in January.

item.title: Morphy estimates an Oscar Heyman necklace at 40.3% of invoice
item.description: The original invoice in the lot's box reads $620,000 against a $150,000 to $250,000 estimate. Morphy offers 357 lots at Denver, Pennsylvania on 24 September.

item.title: Rolex holds 31% of Chrono24 sales as under-30 buyers pull back
item.description: The marketplace puts Omega at about 11% and Patek Philippe at about 6%. Buyers under 30 have cut the share of their spending devoted to Rolex by about 30% since 2022.

item.title: Palladium sheds $97 to $1,280 since Monday's mark
item.description: Gold, silver and platinum each lost between 1.27% and 1.87% over the same four sessions. Kitco's last print of the week carries a 17:00 timestamp of 11 September on all four metals.

item.title: Gemfields sells all 44 emerald lots for $29.6 million
item.description: The commercial-quality sale cleared at $9.72 a carat, up 30.3% on the November-December auction's $7.46. Bidding companies numbered 63, the widest field of the five most recent commercial sales.

item.title: Silver sheds $2.19 to $63.94 since the 9 September mark
item.description: All four metals sit below the 9 September marks, though Kitco's own Friday session prints every one higher. Palladium fell 3.37% to $1,290.00, platinum 2.39% and gold 0.96%.

item.title: Bulgari sapphire ring carries a HKD 9.5m high estimate
item.description: The 9.86-carat cushion Kashmir stone tops 95 lots at Phillips Hong Kong on 29 September. At the high estimate it works out to HKD 963,500 a carat, about $1.2 million for the ring.

item.title: Urwerk launches a gold UR-150 at $140,000, 25 pieces
item.description: The 18-carat yellow gold case is listed at CHF 105,000 before tax in Switzerland, 19.3% over the titanium version. Urwerk made 50 of that one, per variant.

item.title: Kay cuts its assortment about 20% across 1,003 stores
item.description: Signet's largest banner is adding men's shops in about 200 locations and piloting open-sell Rocksbox cases. Store and packaging changes follow in 2027, under a campaign named Love All In.

item.title: Pudong Development Bank ends retail gold trading on 25 September
item.description: The bank closes agency access to Shanghai Gold Exchange personal precious-metals trading across mobile, online and counter channels. ICBC and China Construction Bank shut the same business on 24 July; three more banks went earlier in 2026.

item.title: Sotheby's offers HKD 2m colored-diamond earrings without reserve
item.description: The lot pairs a 2.08-carat light pink pear shape with a 2.21-carat very light pink VVS1 stone. More than 300 pieces sell in Hong Kong, including Graff, Tiffany and Hermès.

item.title: Heritage puts a $250,000 high estimate on a 22.09-carat yellow
item.description: The Internally Flawless stone, documented to South Africa's Kimberley mine, leads the 28 September Fall Fine Jewelry Signature Auction. Heritage calls it the Kimberley Sunshine and puts the low at $200,000.

item.title: Palladium sheds $36.00 to $1,335.00 on the 8 September mark
item.description: Gold eased $9.80 to $4,389.30 on Kitco's bid, platinum added $12.00 to $1,841.00 and silver $0.184 to $66.13. Palladium's bid-ask spread widened to 2.9963%.

item.title: Signet comps rise 2.2% as total sales fall 0.5%
item.description: 53 stores closed and 5 opened since year-end, leaving 2,534 open. Adjusted earnings guidance rises to $10.45 to $12.15 a share from $9.20 to $11.00.

item.title: Mouawad parure sells for $78,277 against a $153,085 high estimate
item.description: Bonhams Hong Kong sold the four-piece set for HKD 613,600 at its 2 September online sale, HKD 586,400 short of the high estimate. Every other named lot cleared inside its range.

item.title: CIBJO backs 'synthetic' alone, FTC holds three terms to 2028
item.description: The confederation's general assembly and board took up the change in Vicenza on 7 September. Its lab-grown committee had asked to keep one alternative term, and its coloured stone commission voted the same way.

item.title: Platinum adds $6.00 to $1,829.00, Kitco's only riser
item.description: Kitco's bid put gold at $4,399.10, silver at $65.946 and palladium at $1,371.00, all three lower on the board's own session change. The gold-silver ratio narrowed to 66.7 ounces from 67.1 at the 7 September mark.
